versionNote: Home slow-braised version. Restaurant uses more oil and a harder tomato breakdown.
versionNoteZh: 家常慢炖版。餐厅版用油更重，番茄更烂。
story: Tomato beef brisket is a Shanghai classic — sweet from the tomatoes, rich from the brisket. This home version gives the tomatoes time to melt into the broth, creating a reddish sauce without ketchup.
storyZh: 番茄牛腩是上海经典家常菜——番茄的甜味融入牛腩，汤汁呈自然的红色，不加番茄酱。

ingredients.note: Red and soft for best flavor release.
ingredients.noteZh: 选择熟透红润的番茄风味更好。

steps.text: Blanch brisket: place chunks in a pot, cover with cold water, bring to boil. Skim foam, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 焯水去腥：牛腩块冷水下锅，烧开撇去浮沫，捞出冲洗。

steps.text: Heat oil in a heavy pot. Add onion, ginger, star anise. Fry 1 min until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油，下洋葱、姜片、八角，炒 1 分钟出香。

steps.text: Add brisket, toss to coat. Pour in soy sauces and rock sugar. Stir 2 min until colored.
steps.textZh: 下牛腩翻炒，加生抽、老抽、冰糖，炒 2 分钟上色。

steps.text: Add tomatoes and hot water. Boil, then reduce to low. Cover simmer 45 min.
steps.textZh: 加番茄和热水，烧开转小火，盖盖炖 45 分钟。

steps.text: Stir softened tomatoes, continue simmer 20-30 min until fork-tender.
steps.textZh: 搅拌让番茄融化，继续炖 20-30 分钟至软烂。

stateNote.signal: Fork slides in with no resistance

steps.text: Taste, adjust salt. Serve with steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 尝味调味，搭配米饭。

tips: Choose brisket with visible fat marbling.
Tomatoes must be ripe for best flavor.
Don't skip blanching — cleaner broth.
tipsZh: 选带大理石纹的牛腩。
番茄必须熟透。
焯水不能省——汤更清。

titleEn: Daikon Beef Brisket Stew (白萝卜炖牛腩)
pinyin: bái luó bo dùn niú ruǎn
versionNote: Lighter Cantonese style — the daikon absorbs beef broth and becomes sweet and melt-in-your-mouth.
versionNoteZh: 粤式清淡版——白萝卜吸饱牛腩汤，变得清甜软糯。
story: In Cantonese home cooking, daikon and beef are a classic pairing. The radish soaks up the rich beef fat and becomes sweeter than most vegetables. This is a warming winter dish found in every Guangdong household.
storyZh: 在广东家常菜中，白萝卜和牛腩是经典搭配。萝卜吸饱牛腩的油脂，比大多数蔬菜更甜。这是一道粤式冬日暖菜。

ingredients.nameEn: daikon radish, peeled and cut into thick rounds

steps.text: Blanch brisket: cold water, bring to boil, skim foam, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 焯水：冷水下锅烧开，撇沫，捞出冲洗。

steps.text: Heat oil, add ginger, scallions, star anise. Fry 30s until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 锅中放油，下姜片、葱段、八角，炒 30 秒出香。

steps.text: Add brisket, stir 2 min. Pour in soy sauce and rock sugar.
steps.textZh: 下牛腩翻炒 2 分钟，加生抽和冰糖。

steps.text: Add hot water, bring to boil. Cover and simmer 60 min on low.
steps.textZh: 加热水烧开，盖盖小火炖 60 分钟。

steps.text: Add daikon rounds. Cover and simmer another 30 min until daikon is translucent and tender.
steps.textZh: 加白萝卜块，继续盖盖炖 30 分钟至萝卜透明软烂。

steps.text: Season with salt. Garnish with scallion greens. Serve hot.
steps.textZh: 盐调味，撒葱花，趁热食用。

tips: Daikon should be cut thick — it shrinks but not too much.
Don't add daikon too early or it will disintegrate.
The broth is the star — drink it separately if you like.
tipsZh: 萝卜切大块——会缩水但不会太厉害。
萝卜不要早放，否则会煮散。
汤是灵魂——可以单独喝。

titleEn: Clear Broth Daikon Beef (清炖萝卜牛腩)
pinyin: qīng dùn luó bo niú ruǎn
versionNote: Cantonese clear-broth style — light, clean, highlights the natural sweetness of daikon and beef.
versionNoteZh: 粤式清炖——清淡鲜美，突出白萝卜和牛肉的原味。
story: Cantonese cooking values the natural flavor of ingredients above all. This clear-broth beef and daikon soup is a temple to that philosophy — simple, clean, deeply satisfying.
storyZh: 粤菜最重食材本味。这道清炖牛腩萝卜是这一哲学的体现——简单、干净、令人满足。

ingredients.nameEn: daikon radish, peeled and cut into thick rounds

steps.text: Blanch brisket: cold water, bring to boil, skim foam thoroughly, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 牛腩冷水下锅，烧开撇净浮沫，捞出冲洗干净。

steps.text: In a clean pot, add brisket, ginger, and cooking wine. Cover with hot water.
steps.textZh: 另取干净锅，放入牛腩、姜片、料酒，加热水没过食材。

steps.text: Bring to boil, then reduce to the lowest possible heat. Skim any foam that rises.
steps.textZh: 烧开转最小火，撇去浮沫。

steps.text: Simmer 45 min. Add daikon rounds. Cover and cook another 20-25 min until both are tender.
steps.textZh: 炖 45 分钟后加白萝卜，继续盖盖炖 20-25 分钟至都软烂。

steps.text: Season with salt and white pepper. Garnish with cilantro. Serve in bowls with broth.
steps.textZh: 盐和白胡椒调味，撒香菜，连汤带肉食用。

tips: Keep the heat low — a rolling boil will make the broth cloudy.
This soup is best when the broth is crystal clear.
Daikon becomes sweeter the longer it cooks — don't rush it.
tipsZh: 火要小——大火会让汤浑浊。
汤要清澈才好喝。
萝卜越炖越甜——别急。

titleEn: Tomato Beef Brisket Noodles (番茄牛腩面)
versionNote: Comfort food bowl — noodles in rich tomato-beef broth.
versionNoteZh: 暖胃面条——番茄牛腩汤底配面条。
story: A bowl of tomato beef brisket noodles is the ultimate comfort food in Shanghai homes. The noodles soak up the reddish-brown broth, and the tender brisket makes it a complete meal.
storyZh: 番茄牛腩面是上海人家的终极 comfort food。面条吸饱红褐色汤汁，配上软烂牛腩，就是一顿完整的大餐。

steps.text: Blanch brisket in cold water, skim foam, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 牛腩冷水下锅，烧开撇沫，捞出冲洗。

steps.text: Heat oil, add ginger. Fry 30s. Add tomatoes, stir-fry until soft and broken down.
steps.textZh: 热油下姜片爆香 30 秒，下番茄翻炒至软烂。

steps.text: Add brisket, soy sauce, rock sugar. Stir 2 min.
steps.textZh: 下牛腩、生抽、冰糖，炒 2 分钟。

steps.text: Add hot water. Bring to boil, reduce to low. Cover and simmer 45 min.
steps.textZh: 加热水烧开，转小火盖盖炖 45 分钟。

steps.text: Meanwhile, cook noodles in boiling salted water according to package. Drain.
steps.textZh: 同时另锅烧水，下面条煮熟捞出。

stateNote.visual: Noodles float and no white center

steps.text: Season broth with salt. Place noodles in bowl, ladle hot beef-tomato broth and brisket on top. Garnish with scallions.
steps.textZh: 汤汁盐调味。碗底放面条，浇上牛腩番茄汤，撒葱花。

tips: Use ripe tomatoes for the best color and sweetness.
Noodles should be al dente — they'll soften in the hot broth.
Save some broth to drink separately if you like.
tipsZh: 番茄要熟透——颜色甜味都好。
面条煮到 al dente——会在热汤里继续软化。
汤可以单独喝。

titleEn: Red Wine Beef Brisket (红酒炖牛腩)
versionNote: Western technique meets Chinese brisket — the wine tenderizes and adds depth.
versionNoteZh: 西式技法配中式牛腩——红酒软化肉质增添深度。
story: Shanghai's cosmopolitan history means fusion dishes are common. This red wine beef brisket uses Chinese braising techniques with a French wine base — the result is a deeply savory, tender dish that's perfect for dinner guests.
storyZh: 上海开放的历史带来融合菜常见。这道红酒炖牛腩用法式红酒做底配中式烧技法——结果是一道深咸酥烂的待客菜。

steps.text: Pat brisket dry, season with salt and pepper. Sear in hot oil until deeply browned on all sides. Remove.
steps.textZh: 牛腩擦干，撒盐胡椒。热油下锅四面煎至上色，捞出。

steps.text: In the same pot, sauté onion, carrot, and garlic until softened. Add tomato paste, stir 1 min.
steps.textZh: 同锅炒洋葱胡萝卜蒜至软，加番茄膏炒 1 分钟。

steps.text: Pour in wine, scrape up browned bits. Add soy sauce, star anise, bay leaves, and broth.
steps.textZh: 倒红酒，刮起锅边焦香物质。加生抽、八角、香叶、高汤。

steps.text: Return beef to pot. Bring to boil, reduce to low. Cover and simmer 90 min.
steps.textZh: 放回牛肉，烧开转小火盖盖炖 90 分钟。

steps.text: Check tenderness — beef should be fork-tender. If needed, simmer uncovered 10-15 min to thicken sauce.
steps.textZh: 检查软烂度——牛腩应 fork-tender。如需要，开盖再煮 10-15 分钟收汁。

steps.text: Remove star anise and bay leaves. Adjust seasoning. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice.
steps.textZh: 捞出八角香叶，调味，配土豆泥或米饭食用。

tips: Use a wine you'd actually drink — cheap wine makes cheap sauce.
Don't skip the sear — it creates fond (browned bits) that flavors the sauce.
This dish is even better the next day — flavors deepen overnight.
tipsZh: 用能喝的酒——便宜酒做便宜 sauce。
煎肉不能省——锅边的焦香物质是风味来源。
隔夜更美味——风味会融合加深。

titleEn: Chu Hou Sauce Beef (柱候酱牛腩)
versionNote: Cantonese Chu Hou sauce is a fermented soybean paste with garlic and five-spice. It's the soul of this dish.
versionNoteZh: 粤式柱候酱是发酵豆酱加蒜和五香粉，是这道菜的灵魂。
story: Chu Hou sauce originates from Foshan, Guangdong and is a staple of Cantonese home cooking. This beef brisket in Chu Hou sauce has a deep umami-savory flavor that's uniquely Cantonese.
storyZh: 柱候酱源自广东佛山，是粤式家常菜必备。这道柱候牛腩有独特的鲜香咸味，是典型的粤式风味。

ingredients.nameEn: Chu Hou sauce (or hoisin as substitute)
ingredients.note: Hoisin sauce is the closest substitute if you can't find Chu Hou.
ingredients.noteZh: 找不到柱候酱可用海鲜酱替代。

steps.text: Blanch brisket in cold water, skim foam, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 牛腩冷水下锅，烧开撇沫，捞出冲洗。

steps.text: Heat oil, fry ginger, garlic, and star anise until fragrant (30s).
steps.textZh: 热油下姜片、蒜瓣、八角爆香 30 秒。

steps.text: Add brisket, stir-fry 3 min until colored. Add Chu Hou sauce, soy sauce, rock sugar.
steps.textZh: 下牛腩炒 3 分钟上色，加柱候酱、生抽、冰糖。

steps.text: Add hot water. Bring to boil, reduce to low. Cover and simmer 60 min.
steps.textZh: 加热水烧开，转小火盖盖炖 60 分钟。

steps.text: Check tenderness — beef should be fork-tender. If sauce is thin, simmer uncovered 10 min to reduce.
steps.textZh: 检查软烂度——牛腩应 fork-tender。如汤汁稀，开盖收汁 10 分钟。

steps.text: Garnish with scallions. Serve with rice or noodles.
steps.textZh: 撒葱花，配米饭或面条食用。

tips: Chu Hou sauce is hard to find outside China — hoisin is the best substitute but less complex.
Don't rush the simmer — low and slow is the only way to tenderize brisket.
This dish pairs excellently with plain steamed rice.
tipsZh: 柱候酱国外难找——海鲜酱是最好的替代但风味不如。
别急——慢炖是软化的唯一方法。
配白米饭绝佳。

versionNote: Cantonese-style curry uses more coconut milk and milder curry powder than Indian versions.
versionNoteZh: 粤式咖喱用更多椰浆、更温和的咖喱粉，不同于印度版本。
story: Cantonese curry beef is a beloved dish with Portuguese influence — the colonial history of Macau and Guangzhou brought curry to the region. This version uses mild curry powder and coconut milk for a creamy, warming stew.
storyZh: 粤式咖喱牛腩是深受喜爱的融合菜——澳门和广州的殖民历史把咖喱带到了这个地区。这道用温和咖喱粉和椰浆做出 creamy 暖身炖菜。

steps.text: Blanch brisket in cold water, skim foam, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 牛腩冷水下锅，烧开撇沫，捞出冲洗。

steps.text: Heat oil, fry onion until translucent. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder. Stir 30s until fragrant.
steps.textZh: 热油炒洋葱至透明，下蒜姜末和咖喱粉，炒 30 秒出香。

steps.text: Add brisket, stir to coat. Pour in soy sauce and coconut milk.
steps.textZh: 下牛腩翻炒裹匀，倒入生抽和椰浆。

steps.text: Add potatoes and enough water to just cover. Bring to boil, reduce to low. Cover and simmer 60 min.
steps.textZh: 加土豆和适量水没过食材，烧开转小火盖盖炖 60 分钟。

steps.text: Potatoes should be tender and sauce thickened. Season with salt.
steps.textZh: 土豆应软烂，酱汁浓稠。盐调味。

steps.text: Serve over steamed rice. Garnish with cilantro if desired.
steps.textZh: 配米饭食用，可撒香菜。

tips: Use full-fat coconut milk for best texture.
Potatoes absorb curry flavor — they're often the first to go.
Adjust curry powder to taste — start with less and add more.
tipsZh: 用全脂椰浆口感最好。
土豆吸咖喱味——往往最先光盘。
咖喱粉按口味调整——先少后加。

titleEn: Tofu Skin Beef Casserole (腐竹牛腩煲)
versionNote: Claypot style — tofu skin soaks up all the beef broth and becomes the star.
versionNoteZh: 煲仔风格——腐竹吸饱牛腩汤，成为主角。
story: Tofu skin (yuba) is a Cantonese delicacy made from the skin that forms on simmering soy milk. When braised with beef brisket, it absorbs the rich broth and becomes a meaty, umami-rich morsel that many prefer over the beef itself.
storyZh: 腐竹是粤式美食，由豆浆煮沸后凝结的皮制成。和牛腩一起炖煮时吸饱浓郁汤汁，成为鲜美多汁的食材，很多人比牛肉还爱它。

ingredients.note: Soak in warm water for 30 min before use.
ingredients.noteZh: 使用前温水泡发 30 分钟。

steps.text: Soak dried tofu skin in warm water for 30 min until soft. Cut into 5cm lengths. Drain.
steps.textZh: 腐竹温水泡发 30 分钟至软，切 5cm 段，沥干。

steps.text: Blanch brisket in cold water, skim foam, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 牛腩冷水下锅，烧开撇沫，捞出冲洗。

steps.text: Heat oil, fry ginger and star anise 30s. Add brisket, stir-fry 3 min.
steps.textZh: 热油下姜片、八角爆香 30 秒，下牛腩炒 3 分钟。

steps.text: Add soy sauces and rock sugar. Stir 2 min. Add hot water.
steps.textZh: 加生抽、老抽、冰糖，炒 2 分钟，加热水。

steps.text: Bring to boil, add daikon. Reduce to low. Cover and simmer 40 min.
steps.textZh: 烧开加白萝卜，转小火盖盖炖 40 分钟。

steps.text: Add soaked tofu skin. Cover and cook 15 min more until everything is tender and flavors meld.
steps.textZh: 加腐竹，盖盖再炖 15 分钟至入味软烂。

steps.text: Transfer to a claypot or serve directly. Garnish with scallions.
steps.textZh: 转砂锅或直接上桌，撒葱花。

tips: Tofu skin is a sponge — it will soak up all the flavorful broth.
Don't soak tofu skin too long or it becomes mushy.
Serve in a claypot to keep warm at the table.
tipsZh: 腐竹是海绵——会吸光所有美味汤汁。
腐竹别泡太久否则会烂。
用砂锅上桌可以保温。

titleEn: Shacha Sauce Beef Brisket (沙茶牛腩)
versionNote: Shacha sauce is a Fujianese chili-garlic-peanut sauce. It's savory, slightly sweet, and deeply aromatic.
versionNoteZh: 沙茶酱是福建辣椒蒜花生酱——咸鲜微甜，香气深沉。
story: Shacha sauce comes from Fujian province and has Southeast Asian influences — it contains dried shrimp, garlic, chili, and peanuts. This beef brisket version is a Fujianese home classic, often served over rice or noodles.
storyZh: 沙茶酱源自福建，有东南亚影响——含虾米、蒜、辣椒和花生。这道牛腩是福建家常经典，常配米饭或面条。

ingredients.note: Shacha sauce is available in Asian supermarkets. If unavailable, satay sauce works.
ingredients.noteZh: 亚超有售。没有可用沙嗲酱替代。

steps.text: Blanch brisket in cold water, skim foam, drain and rinse.
steps.textZh: 牛腩冷水下锅，烧开撇沫，捞出冲洗。

steps.text: Heat oil, fry garlic, ginger, and scallion whites until fragrant (30s).
steps.textZh: 热油下蒜末、姜片、葱白爆香 30 秒。

steps.text: Add brisket, stir-fry 3 min. Add Shacha sauce, soy sauce, rock sugar. Stir to coat.
steps.textZh: 下牛腩炒 3 分钟，加沙茶酱、生抽、冰糖，翻炒裹匀。

steps.text: Add hot water. Bring to boil, reduce to low. Cover and simmer 60 min.
steps.textZh: 加热水烧开，转小火盖盖炖 60 分钟。

steps.text: Check tenderness — beef should be fork-tender. Simmer uncovered 10 min to thicken sauce if needed.
steps.textZh: 检查软烂度——牛腩应 fork-tender。如需要，开盖收汁 10 分钟。

steps.text: Garnish with scallion greens. Serve with steamed rice.
steps.textZh: 撒葱绿，配米饭食用。

tips: Shacha sauce varies by brand — taste and adjust.
This sauce is great over rice or noodles — the extra sauce is perfect for soaking.
Add a pinch of sugar if the sauce is too salty.
tipsZh: 沙茶酱品牌不同——尝味调整。
这酱汁配米饭面条都绝——多留点汤汁拌饭。
太咸就加 pinch 糖。
